title: A decade in the making, bridge linking Kottayam, Alappuzha set to open soon
description: The 800-metre-long Nerekadavu-Makkekadavu bridge across Vembanad Lake connects Udayanapuram grama panchayat in Kottayam with Thaikkattussery panchayat in Alappuzha. Construction of the bridge has been completed while work is under way on the approach roads on either side and the retaining walls
